# Covison CRM

> Covison CRM is a completely free customer relationship management tool
> for small businesses and teams. No trial period, no credit card
> required, free forever.

Covison CRM brings contacts, companies, deals, tasks, and support tickets
into one calm, uncluttered workspace, so a team spends less time managing
tools and more time working with customers.

## Pricing

Covison CRM is free. There is no paid tier, no trial period, and no
credit card is required to sign up.

## Core features

- Contacts and companies: full CRUD, CSV import/export, notes, search and
  filters, per-user column customization.
- Sales pipeline: a kanban deal board with customizable stages.
- Tasks: assign and track work across a team.
- Support tickets: status, priority, and category tracking.
- Saved views: team-shareable filters on every list.
- CSV import/export on contacts, companies, deals, tickets, and tasks.
- Lead types with custom fields, defined per organization.
- Role-based team access.
- In-app notifications on assignment.
- Activity and notes timeline on every record.

## Getting started

Sign up at https://crm.covison.com/auth/sign-up with just an email
address. No payment details are required.

## About

Covison CRM is a product of Covison, https://covison.com.
